parsed.post: Latest experiment with DEPTH=6 slightly regressed (1.092289 vs 1.092248). Reverting to previous best. I suspect the increased capacity might require a more tuned learning rate or longer warmup to stabilize.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=4 and increasing learning rate and warmup ratio to see if faster convergence can be achieved without the instability seen in the higher depth run.
